name: AugmentiQ
description: Persistent agent memory in your Obsidian vault, via the AugmentiQ Obsidian plugin's embedded MCP server. Exposes the 5 AugmentIQ contract tools (governance-skill compatible) plus the consumer memory loop tool. 100% local: the server binds 127.0.0.1 only, bearer-token auth, hash-chained audit log.

token.description: Bearer token for the AugmentiQ MCP server. Copy from the Obsidian plugin (ribbon icon or Settings → AugmentiQ). Prefer a SecretRef: {"$ref": "secrets://AUGMENTIQ_TOKEN"}.
